name: Shishime Subaru
source:
Birth year: 1994

Main character of episode 1
Having fulfilled all his desires, Subaru decided to withdraw from society and formed a small community called "village". He is well known for being the creator of TPN, an indispensable information sharing platform for Gnostic Child (GC).
Subaru becomes [url=/c92637]Rei[/url]'s caretaker after his parents' death in a large-scale conflict in 2039. A wise person with a calming mindset, he is also the first person to notice [url=/c92637]Rei[/url]'s power.
